items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I met all kinds of great people: The LaBarbara’s, Joe and Pat LaBarbara and Don Menza

ctx.x: And I’m sure you’re not the first person to say that either.

But he did teach me some really good — and I met all kinds of great people: The LaBarbara’s, Joe and Pat LaBarbara and Don Menza and Joe Romano and Art Pepper was on the band and Al Porcino, I roomed with Al Porcino.
